picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals a major new national push to apply AI to accelerate scientific discovery, from particle physics to materials — a bellwether for how federal science funding is being reoriented around AI.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20M MRC-funded hub combining stem cell models with AI-driven drug discovery represents a substantial, well-resourced bet on accelerating medicine development — the kind of cross-disciplinary infrastructure investment that can reshape an entire research pipeline.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: Using generative AI to design entirely novel proteins not found in nature — building on Nobel Prize-winning computational protein engineering — is a genuine scientific frontier with direct implications for medicine and biotechnology.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial tumor proteomics could meaningfully improve treatment response prediction across many cancer types, a rare case of AI directly advancing precision oncology.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's DOE Genesis Mission awards for AI-driven quantum error correction and national-lab data sharing show the federal AI-for-science initiative extending into quantum computing infrastructure, a strategically important research area.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM system, developed with Mayo Clinic and the University of Florida, pairs AI with wearable sensors to guide medical procedures — a concrete cross-sector partnership aimed at real clinical impact.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: RoboDojo, a nearly 20-university effort led by HKU with UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes a much-needed shared benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability — the sort of standard-setting work that shapes an entire subfield's trajectory.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: A University of Alabama-Fermilab Genesis Mission partnership to apply AI to high-energy physics data illustrates how national labs and universities are teaming up under DOE's new AI initiative to tackle problems at massive data scale.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: DOE funding for University of Arkansas research to defend AI systems safeguarding the electric grid against adversarial attacks addresses a critical infrastructure security gap with direct national policy relevance.
picks.title: DOE Funds U of A Research to Safeguard the AI Behind America's Electric Grid

picks.editorial_note: A $12M Army Research Laboratory grant for animal-inspired AI sensing in autonomous drones and robots is a substantial defense-funded bet on next-generation battlefield and field-robotics perception.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University
